title: Program Director
description: Job Summary Program Director role responsible for shaping and driving complex enterprise programs focused on secure adoption of Azure platforms ensuring strategic alignment with long term business goals and regulatory expectations while optimizing hybrid working models and enhancing resilience of digital services that support global transactions and modern payment ecosystems. Responsibilities Drive end to end ownership of large scale technology programs that focus on secure Azure adoption while ensuring alignment with enterprise strategy and regulatory obligations across all business units and global locations. Coordinate risk assessment activities to identify security gaps within Azure workloads and associated payment services then translate findings into prioritized remediation plans with measurable outcomes. Provide direction for establishing program wide security governance structures including policies standards and procedures that embed Azure security practices into everyday operations and decision making. Align program deliverables with organizational strategy by ensuring that Azure security investments support long term growth improved customer trust and efficient digital payment experiences. Manage stakeholder expectations by communicating program status risks and achievements through concise narratives and dashboards that highlight progress toward secure cloud and payment transformation goals. Drive continuous improvement by analyzing operational metrics incident trends and audit results to refine Azure security capabilities and strengthen resilience of transaction and payment platforms. Collaborate with finance and portfolio management partners to optimize program budgets and investment decisions ensuring that Azure security and payment initiatives deliver tangible business value. Enable hybrid work effectiveness by promoting secure access models identity controls and collaboration tools that protect program information while supporting flexible working arrangements. Mentor senior program managers and technical leads by sharing best practices in strategic leadership Azure security risk management and stakeholder engagement to build strong succession pipelines. Advance responsible technology outcomes by ensuring that security design decisions within Azure platforms contribute to safer financial transactions and more trustworthy digital experiences for society. Qualifications Apply deep experience in Azure security including identity access management network protection data security and compliance configuration to design secure program architectures and guardrails. Demonstrate strong strategic leadership capabilities by setting program vision influencing senior stakeholders and guiding complex decision making that balances risk cost and long term business impact. Leverage exposure to forex payments or broader financial transaction domains to interpret regulatory expectations operational risks and customer experience needs within secure digital payment programs. Use extensive experience in large enterprise environments to coordinate multidisciplinary teams vendors and partners while maintaining clarity of goals timelines and quality expectations. Employ advanced communication and negotiation skills to manage diverse stakeholders by turning technical security topics into understandable implications for business performance and customer trust. Draw on more than twenty two years of progressive program management experience to handle ambiguity orchestrate transformation agendas and deliver consistent outcomes over multi year horizons. Implement industry recognized frameworks for program management and security governance ensuring that practices are repeatable auditable and aligned with organizational policies and external regulations. Certifications Required Preferred certifications include Azure Security Engineer Associate and Certified Information Systems Security Professional CISSP or equivalent cloud security credentials.
